mchod rten gyi lha las bdud rtsi babs pa de yin zhing*/ de las lhag pa med cing gzhan dgos par yang ma gsungs so// de bzhin du gzungs rdor mi dgos pa'i bum sgrub mang po yod do// yang dung chos su mchod yon bshams nas rjes chog gi mjug tu bum chu dang bsres pa la ni ma 'brel ba'i skyon gnyis snang ste/ dung chos kyi chu'i dgos pa'i gtso bo ni/ de phul bas bum pa'i lha zhu bar byed pa yin la/ 'di ni bum par lha bskyed pa med cing*/ mchod rten gyi lha la ni rab gnas bya dgos pas ma 'brel pa kho na'o// gal te bum par lha bskyed pa med kyang*/ de bsham pa mi 'gal lo snyam na/ de ltar na kun rig gi bum bskyed bsdus pa dang*/ rab gnas kyi khrus bum brgyad la sogs pa la yang dung chos su chu dgos par 'gyur te/ de rnams kyi sgrub tshul la khyad par med pa'i phyir ro// de bzhin du bum pa'i kha rgyan ku sha 'jog pa yang 'brel med pa kho nar zad do// mdor na lag len de dag ni gzhung dang mthun pa'i skabs don ma rnyed pa'i mdzes chos nyid du shes par bya'o// de nas bzlas pa'i grangs tshang zhing stong mchod rnams grub nas gtor ma 'bul ba la sogs pa bya'o// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni dkyus bzhin du bya ste rtogs par sla'o// gnyis pa bye brag tu nyams su blangs pa gnas skabs kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ma gtogs pa'i bzhi bcu zhe bzhi po thams cad yin pas blo gros dang ldan pa dag gis rtog pa rtsa 'grel gyi don mkhas pa'i drung du legs par sbyangs nas khongs su chud par bya ste 'dir mang ba'i 'jigs pas ma bris so// gsum pa phan yon la gnyis te/ gnas skabs dang*/ mthar thug gi phan yon no// dang po ni/ gong du drangs pa'i 'chi bdag gi dbyug pa 'dzin pa zhes pa'i rjes su dag byed sdig pa 'joms par byed pa ni/ gro ga'am gzhan zhig la bris te/

mchod rten gyi nang du bzhag la/ rab tu rgya che ba'i mchod pa ji ltar 'byor pas mchod/ bskor ba stong phrag brgya byas na mchog gi tshe dang blo rno ba sbyin par byed par 'gyur ro// de ltar byas pas zhag bdun thub pa'i tshe ni lo bdun thub bo// lo bdun thub pa'i tshe ni lo bcu bdun thub bo// de ltar mchog gi tshe thub cing dran pa dang ldan pa dang*/ nad med pa dang skye ba dran par 'gyur ro// zhes sogs dang*/ gal te rang gis ma nus na de'i tshe rang dang 'dra bas byas na zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro// zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs shing*/ mthar thug gi phan yon ral gri sgrub pa'i skabs las/ sems can thams cad kyi gcig tu 'dren pa por gyur nas/ sman pa chen po'i mchog tshe dpag tu med par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs so// a ho/ 'gro ba'i sems nyid yid bzhin nor bu las nyon gyi// 'dam du byings pa lus ngag bya ba'i thabs mkhas chus// rnam par sbyangs nas thabs mchog rgyal mtshan rtser bkod de// phan bde'i char 'bebs bya rgyud bstan pa'i snying po yin// de las ston mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug sras kyi gtso// chos kyi 'byung gnas rnam 'phrul mchog gyur lha mchog rnams// sgrub cing mchod tshul 'khrul zad brgyud pa'i srol bzhin sbyar// de yi dge tshogs bdud rtsi'i char gyis don gnyer dang*// srid gsum 'gro ba'i nor 'dzin ma lus khyab gyur nas// gnas skabs phan bde'i dbyar skyes thams cad rgyas pa dang*// mthar thugs 'bras bu rnam rgyal go 'phang thob gyur cig /ces pa gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i chos skor gyi rnam gzhag rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa gong ma rnams kyi bka' srol gtsang ma rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la bka' babs pa'i phyag len ma nyams pa deng sang gi bar du byung zhing*/ de nyid phyis kyang mi nyams par bya ba'i phyir dang*/

don gnyer rnams la yid ches bskyed par bya ba'i slad du/ shākya'i dge slong gsang sngags 'dzin pa dpal ldan don grub kyis dpal e wam̐ chos ldan du sbyar ba'o// ༈ /mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal ma'i bsnyen thabs bzhugs// oṃ swa sti/ rnam rgyal gyi bsnyen pa la gnas gtsang zhing dben par/ rten gyi drung du rnam rgyal dang cha gsum gtor ma rnams mchod pa dang bcas bsham/ mtshams bcad dam la gtsang sbra che bas thun bzhi'am gsum du bcad la/ skyabs 'gro nas bzung ste bdag bskyed byas la/ bzlas pa'i tshe thog mar gzungs ring nyung mthar tshar gsum/ de nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta sogs yi ge bcu pa la grangs bzung

bsnyen tshad gzungs ring stong phrag sogs ci nus dang*/ yi ge bcu pa 'bum phrag bcu kha skong dang bcas pa/ gzhan gnyis kyang ci nus tsam bzla ba phyag len no// thun bsdu ba'i tshe gzungs thung ci nus bzla ba sogs bdag bskyed kyi mjug rnams bya/ de nas thun thams cad kyi rjes su gtor ma rnams cho ga dkyus ltar btang*/ 'di'i yi dam gtor ma'i nam mkhar mchod rten lha dgu dang bcas pa skad cig gis bskyed pa'am/ de yang ma grub na bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa nam mkhar byon pa la gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab/ ma grub na snga thun gyi/ gshegs gsol rnams byas te/ de'i rjes su cha gsum byas pas 'thus lags/ gzhan bsam don rnams yig cha nyid la zhib tu gzigs pa byin rlabs che bas de bzhin mdzod/ maṅga lam̐// ༈ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sbyin sreg gi tho yig 'chi med 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// swa sti bi dza ya/ rnam par rgyal ma'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ sngags kyi nus pa dbyung zhing kha skong ba dang*/ sdig sgrib zhi ba'i phyir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas/ zhi ba'i thab lag len ltar byas te/ lha dgu'i mtshan ma dgod/ kha khyer gyi steng du bud shing brtsig shar lho'i mtshams su me tshang ting lo bzhag thab kyi zhal nub tu phyogs par byas pa'i mdun du sgrub pa po'i stan dang*/ bsang chu rdor dril dgang blugs me yol dkar rtsis byugs te/ ti se'i gangs su bsgom/ sgrub pa por g.yas nas yam shing mar til sogs bsreg rdzas bcu gcig bsham/ g.yon nas chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga/ de'i mdun 'das gtor me lha dang*/ cha gsum gtor ma bsham/ snga dro'am phyi dro'i dus su khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas 'byor na gos rgyan dkar po bya/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa rdzogs par bya/ a mṛ ta nyer gcig gis bsang chu byin gyis brlab/

rdzas rnams la gtor te bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas lha mnyes pa dang so so'i las bsgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ gzungs ring gsum bzlas te/ yam shing gi rtse la mar sbags pa'i sbor mdes me sbar te/ oṃ agne dzwa la raṃ/ zhes brjod cing thab la g.yas nas lan gsum bskor te/ ting lo sbar/ rtsa skam po dang mar sogs kyis me gso/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba nang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ thab tu me tog phul/ oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ thab kyi dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la 'khod pa ni me lha dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dbyug pa dang ral gri/ g.yon phreng ba dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ spro na ku sha spyi ltar phul/ me lha'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ bsam/ dgang blugs gnyis kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ bsam ste/ oṃ agna ye swā hā/ bdun gyi mthar/ oṃ agna ye ā dī bya ma hā shri ye ha bya bahna ya swā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyi byon skyems phul/ mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i mchod pa dang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur bas// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ bsreg rdzas rnams bdun la sogs pa phul spel tshig 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya/

'bul sngags rdzas sngags sam lha sngags gang rung gis bya/ gzhung las skabs 'dir me lha gshegs gsol bshad kyang 'dir spyi ltar mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ agna ye dzwa la ram̐ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur/ me bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las sogs nas lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar gyis lha bskyed/ nye snying sngon 'gro'i byon skyems lan gsum gong ltar phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra re re'i sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /sogs kyis bstod/ yam shing la sogs pa'i bsreg rdzas rnams brgya re 'bul/ rdzas sngags/ oṃ bo dhi bṛkṣa la sogs pa rnams gsum tsam re sngon du btang nas/ nus na gzungs ring mi nus na nye snying gis phul/ spel tshig brgya re'i mjug tu/ bdag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/ gsang sngags kyi lhag chad thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā/ bsreg rdzas thams cad ma 'byor na yam shing mar til tsam gyis chog bsnyen pa'i kha skong bcu cha'i til 'bul/ slar yang gong byon skyems ltar mar dgang blugs gsum dang*/ mchod pa kha gsos te byin gyis brlab pa nas brtsams te/ mchod bstod rgyas bsdus gang rigs bya/ gtor ma dang po bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor bcas la dkyus bzhin phul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa sogs lan gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab bya/ de nas cha gsum btang*/ yig brgya ci nus dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs/ thab kyi rdul cung zad dpral bar bskus te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ mar blugs gzar yang thab tu blugs/

oṃ badzra dzwa la ram̐/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur/ bsreg rdzas lhag ma rnams ci rigs pa phul/ byon skyems ltar gshegs skyems phul/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs te/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas phul/ mchod bstod dang*/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams sogs kyis 'dod don zhu/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// zhes sogs kyis gshegs su gsol/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrung zhing bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis bya'o// de ltar thun gnyis gsum bzhi bsnyen pa'i grangs kyi bcu cha'i kha skong nam ma 'grig par bya/ grol mtshams lnga dro la bya/ mthar thal ba rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor bar bya'o// rgyas pa la sogs pa rnams kyang de dang de'i bsam pa dang ldan pas/ de dang de'i khyad par gyi rdzas rnams dang thab la sogs pa spyi 'gro ltar shes par bya zhing*/ phan yon sogs gzungs dang rtog pa/ de'i ṭī ka rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa dang*/ rnam rgyal rnam bshad mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa sogs zhib tu blta'o// zhes gtsug tor rnam rgyal gyi sbyin sreg gi tho yig 'chi med 'od snang zhes bya ba 'di yang bsnyen pa bgyid pa'i sgrub pa po rnams la phan pa'i ched du dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bkod pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i sgom bzlas snying po bsdus pa 'chi med grub pa'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ bsdus pa'i tshul gyis gtsug tor rnam rgyal bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi spyi ltar sngon du song nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma dang*// a las zla steng bhrūm̐ yig yongs gyur las// rnam rgyal mchod rten mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa'i// bum pa'i nang du pad zlar rang sems bhrūm̐// de las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i dbus// bhrūm̐ yig dkar pos mtshan las 'od zer 'phros// 'phags mchod sems can don byas tshur 'dus pas// rang nyid gtsug tor rnam rgyal ston zla'i mdog

/dkar ser sngo ba'i zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma// zhal rer rab tu rgyas pa'i spyan gsum mdzes// phyag g.yas dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje dang*// gnyis pas pad dkar la gnas 'od dpag med// gsum pas mda' dang bzhi pas mchog sbyin mdzad// g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa dang*// gnyis pas gzhu dang gsum pas skyabs sbyin rgya// bzhi pas mnyam gzhag bdud rtsi'i bum bzang bsnams// dar dang rin chen rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// g.yas su zla ba'i steng du spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar po phyag g.yon padma bsnams// g.yon du nyi mar phyag na rdo rje sngo// phyag g.yon utpal la gnas rdo rje 'dzin// gnyis kas g.yas pas rin chen rnga yab g.yob// zhi tshul bzhengs stabs dar dang rin chen brgyan// shar du mi g.yo sngon po ral gri dang*// lho ru 'dod rgyal sngon po lcags kyu gdengs// nub tu dbyug sngon sngon po dbyug pa dang*// byang du stobs chen sngon po rtse gsum 'phyar// kun kyang g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad// rin chen sbrul rgyan stag lpags sham thabs can// pad nyi'i gdan la g.yon brkyang khros pa'i tshul// gtso mo'i steng gi phyogs gnyis lha yi bu// bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pas sku khrus gsol// kun kyang spyi mgrin thugs kar oṃ āḥhūm̐// dpral bar trām̐ ser lte bar hrīḥdamar po// brla gnyis aṃ āḥljang gus mtshan par gyur// rang gi thugs ka'i bhrūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas// ye shes sems dpa' badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim// slar yang dbang lha rigs lnga spyan drangs nas// dbang bskur sgrib dag gtso mor rnam snang dang*// spyan ras gzigs la bcom ldan 'od dpag med// phyag rdor khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa// lha bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis// dbur brgyan dbang lha rnam kyang rang la thim// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swāhā nas/

shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes sogs ci shes pas bstod/ gtso mo'i thugs kar pad zlar bhrūm̐ yig las// sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba sngon por bhrūm̐/ 'di la bsrung bya dmigs bsal 'dod na/ bhrūm̐ yig gi steng du bla ma/ mdun du pha ma/ g.yas su slob ma/ g.yon du spun zla/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog rnams bsgom par gsungs so/ /dkar gsal gzungs sngags phreng bas bskor ba las// 'od 'phros 'phags mchod 'gro ba'i don kun bsgrubs// sras bcas rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs bsdus// thugs srog la thim tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang*// lung rtogs ye shes mtha' dag rgyas par gyur// ces brjod cing bsams la/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mdzub mo'i tshigs bar pa bcag ste mthe bong gnyis dang rtse sbyar ba legs so ster ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas te gzungs ring tshar gcig brjod/ de nas phyag rgya bkrol te gzungs ring thung gsum po ci nus dang*/ mthar/ oṃ a mi te sogs gzungs 'bring po'ang ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ thun bsdu ba na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.aṃ āḥm ma sarba satwāshtsa rakṣa rakṣa ku ru swā hā/ lan gsum/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun mkhar byon pa la/ gong ltar mchod bstod dang*/ bcom ldan gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma yis// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// dus min 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa zhi ba dang*// tshe dang ye shes dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ oṃ badzra muḥ ye shes 'khor lo chos kyi dbyings su gshegs// dam tshig 'khor dang mchod rten rang la thim// dge ba 'di yis bdag sogs sems can kun// 'chi med 'phags ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog
